Study - Design; country: Randomised trial; 2 groups (attend and avoid); UK
Participants - Characteristics: Current smokers, smoking at least 5 cigarettes per day
Findings: AB at baseline; sig. changes of AB in avoid group; sig. difference in subjective craving between attend and avoid group in males only

Study - Design; country: Double-blind randomised controlled trial; 2 groups (ABM and placebo); UK
Participants - Characteristics: Current smokers, smoking at least 10 cigarettes a day
Outcomes - AB measure: Visual probe task (pictures; 500 ms); pictorial Stroop task
Findings: No AB at baseline; no sig. changes of AB; no difference between groups in craving; abstinence and time until relapse

Study - Design; country: Non-randomised trial; 4 groups (patient and healthy controls, both assigned to either ABM or placebo); UK
Participants - Characteristics: Opiate users in treatment prescribed a substitute medication; healthy controls
Findings: No AB at baseline; no sig. effect on AB or craving

Study - Design; country: Randomised trial; 4 groups (ABM, motivational intervention, ABM + motivational intervention, control group); UK
Participants - Characteristics: Adults drinking above the UK Department of Health cut-off of healthy drinking
Findings: AB at baseline and changes of AB not reported; alcohol consumption reduced in ABM group

Study - Design; country: Randomised trial with 2 groups (ABM and placebo); Netherlands
Participants - Characteristics: Adults smoking on daily basis for at least 1 year
ABM intervention - Method: Modified visual probe task (web-based; pictures; 500 ms)
Outcomes - Symptom measures: FTND; craving; intention to quit smoking
Findings: AB at baseline; no sig. changes of AB; effects on abstinence in subsample of heavy smokers

Study - Design; country: Randomised trial with 5 groups (4 experimental conditions and one placebo group); Netherlands
Participants - Characteristics: Heavy drinking adults as identified with the AUDIT
Findings: No AB at baseline and changes in AB assessed; reduction of drinking and craving, but this was found in all conditions including control group
